title: Get Creative Features - Submitted
description: Async acknowledgement returned after get_creative_features accepts a provider evaluation but cannot complete it within the response window. Exact request replays return this original acknowledgement with replayed: true, the same task_id, and the same evaluation_id. The caller polls get_task_status using task_id; terminal results carry the same evaluation_id.

status.description: Task-level status literal that discriminates this acknowledgement from terminal success and error responses.

task_id.description: AdCP task handle used to poll get_task_status or correlate terminal webhook delivery. Distinct from evaluation_id.

evaluation_id.description: Provider-generated identity allocated when the evaluation is accepted. The terminal result MUST carry this same value. Distinct from task_id and idempotency_key.

message.description: Optional human-readable explanation of why the evaluation is submitted. Plain text only; callers treat it as untrusted provider input.
